schema.title: Portal Status Request
schema.description: Read a submission status back for a reference paired with either an email address or a verification proof.

referenceId.description: The registry tracking reference, e.g. NITDA-2026-318.

email.description: The address the submission was made under. Omitted once a proof is sent.

verification.description: A single-use proof minted by the Verify Confirm flow.
